_browser_backend_comment: Browser layer: 'native' (Python Playwright, default) or 'mcp' (Playwright MCP server, experimental). Toggle via the BACKEND button in the UI. Requires app restart to take effect.

browser._comment: Match the developer's real Chrome settings so fixed/floating elements render correctly. Get values by running: window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight, window.devicePixelRatio in Chrome DevTools console.

tracing._comment: Playwright trace recording. mode: 'on' (every test), 'off', or 'retain-on-failure' (default — save only failed tests). Traces capture DOM snapshots + network + console per action; open with the Trace button or `playwright show-trace <file>`.

network._comment: Per-test API/XHR capture (method, url, request payload, response body, timing) -> results/<ts>/network/<tc_id>.json, shown per step in History. api_only skips static assets; override with ATS_NETWORK=on|off.

pass_criteria._comment: How a test's verdict is decided. mode: 'critical_only' (only a failed CRITICAL-severity checkpoint fails the test; normal/minor failures are recorded as warnings), 'all' (any failure fails), or 'threshold' (pass if >= threshold_pct of checkpoints pass AND every critical passes). treat_skipped_as: ignore|fail|pass. default_severity: applied to checkpoints.run() calls that don't pass severity= (critical = blocking; normal/minor = non-blocking warning). retries: re-run a failed test N times; if a later attempt passes it is labelled FLAKY (requires pytest-rerunfailures).

llm._comment: Pluggable LLM for the explorer (browser-use agent), PRD extraction + test synthesis. Default = Xiaomi MiMo (OpenAI-compatible, key from MIMO_API_KEY) for testing; generalises to any provider. API keys are NEVER stored here — only the env-var name each provider reads.

vision_oracle._comment: Vision model used ONLY for screenshot analysis (overlay/dropdown detection). Set 'model' to the Xiaomi vision model name (e.g. mimo-vl-2.5 — confirm exact name). Uses the same MIMO_API_KEY. The main agent (mimo-v2.5-pro) is never sent images; it receives the text description from this model.
